revision_summary: No fabricated/failed quotes were found (deterministic check returned empty, and manual spot-check confirms quotes are accurate). Required fixes: (1) Correct the schema reference in cherry_pick_moments[4] (ts 05:03) -- protocols.time_constraint is about call/meeting duration objections, not appointment channel (phone vs in-person) mismatch; re-reference to button_up.phone_appointment_specified or flag explicitly as a schema gap since Ion's schema has no defined protocol for channel-expectation mismatches. (2) Soften the severity language around the opening regulatory comment (00:19) -- avoid characterizing it as a 'live doubt hanging over the entire call' when the customer never resurfaces it and cooperates fully through verify; this is a minor/optional coaching note, not a major unresolved trust issue, and should be graded accordingly. (3) Add nuance to state_changes[0] and rep_intent.evidence[1] -- the 'passive compliance not genuine warmth' and 'checklist mentality' reads are plausible but stated as settled fact; per the strategic_vs_reactive analysis directive, offer the alternative hypothesis (rep building general rapport/credibility ahead of specialist-led pitch, consistent with setter_scope_discipline) before settling on the reactive/checklist read. (4) Expand objections[1] or add a cherry_pick_moment to fully quote the customer's 05:11-05:26 counter-offer bundling the bill-email with his own availability check -- this is the load-bearing quote for the outcome_dispute conclusion and deserves full visibility rather than being partially represented. Outcome dispute (no_appointment reclassification) is well-supported and should be retained as-is.
